<pos> m.</pos>

<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">שְׁפִיפֹן; שפף)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>sliding</italic>,] a species of 
<italic>serpents, adder</italic> (?).</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 14
<sup>9</sup> כנגד … נחש וש' corresponding to the two things to which his (Dan’s) father compared him, serpent and 
<italic>sh’fifon</italic>. Sot. 10
<sup>a</sup> בלעם … שנאמר ש' וכ' Balaam was lame in one foot, for we read (Num. XXIII, 3), and he went 
<italic>shefi</italic>; Samson was lame in both feet, for it says (Gen. XLIX, 17) 
<italic>sh’fifon</italic> (sliding) on the road. Y. Ter. VIII, 45
<sup>d</sup> bot. מין קטן הוא ושמו ש' it is a small kind of serpent, its name is 
<italic>sh’fifon</italic>, and it is as thin as a hair.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01757">
<head-word>שְׁפִיר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שפר; cmp. שׁוֹפָר 2, a. שְׁפוֹפֶרֶת) 
<italic>membraneous bag, sac of a fœtus</italic>; in gen. 
<italic>fœtus</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. III, 3 המפלת ש' מלא וכ' if a woman discharges a sac full of water &c. Lev. R. s. 14; Y. Nidd. III, 50
<sup>d</sup> top (ref. to Job XXXVIII, 9) לבושו זה הש' וכ' ‘its garment’ means the sac, ‘its swaddling band’, the placenta. Ib. ש' מרוקם a fœtus having an articulated shape, v. רָשׁוֹן; Bab. ib. 25
<sup>a</sup> ש' שאינו מרוקם a shapeless fœtus. Y. Naz. VII, 56
<sup>b</sup> I have seen עגל כאפון בש' the embryo of a calf, of the size of a bean, in a bag; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01759">
<head-word>שַׁפִּיר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שְׁפַר) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>handsome, pleasing; good; cheerful</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Sam. XVI, 12. Targ. O. Gen. XLVII, 6, (v. שֶׁפֶר ch.); a. fr.—Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI, 6 (in Hebr. dict.) על … נעשה לי ש' because I was content with my portion, it became beautiful to me; Yalk. ib. 667 (corr. acc.).—Kidd. 31
<sup>b</sup> בעינא גברא דש' כותך I want a man as handsome as thou art; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. שַׁפִּירִין, שַׁפִּירַיָּא, שַׁפִּירֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Deut. VIII, 12. Targ. II Chr. VII, 10; a. fr.—B. Mets. 84
<sup>a</sup> אנא … מש' ירושלם I am one of the survivors of the handsome men of Jerusalem. Ib. בני ש' כוותי children as good-looking as I am; a. fr.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. שׁפִּירָא, שַׁפִּירְתָּא, שַׁפִּרְ'. Targ. Gen. XII, 14. Ib. 11. Targ. O. Num. XII, 1; a. fr.—B. Mets. l. c. דש' מינאי who is handsomer than I am; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. שַׁפִּירָן, שַׁפִּירָתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Gen. VI, 2. Targ. Y. ib. 1. Targ. Job XLII, 15; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (adv.) 
<italic>right, well</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. l. c. אטו … דש' קאמינא do I not know that what I say is right? Yoma 29
<sup>b</sup> מאן קא מותיב ש' קא מותיב he who asked that question has asked well. Yeb. 94
<sup>b</sup> והאי ש' נסיב and he married rightly (legally); והא ש' נסיב and he married this one lawfully; a. fr.—ש' דמי, v. דְּמֵי I.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>placing over</italic> or

Ib. 9 כור שיש בו בית ש' a smelting pot which has a bottom or foot whereon it can rest (Mish. ed. בור וכ' a hole in the ground with an arrangement for putting a pot over fire); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01764">
<head-word>שָׁפַךְ</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Shaf</italic>.</definition>
<notes> of הפך) [
<italic>to invert,</italic>] 
<italic>to pour; to empty</italic>. Lam. R. to IV, 11 מזמר אני שהפך חופתו … ולא ש' חמתו וכ' I sing, because he (the king) has upset his son’s bridal chamber, but has not poured out his anger over his son; שש' הקב"ה … ולא ש' because the Lord has poured his anger over wood and stone, and did not pour it out over Israel. Yeb. 75
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXIII, 2) מי שע"י כריתה שׁוֹפֵךְ he who pours (semen, instead of shooting forth, מקלח) in consequence of cutting. Succ. II, 9, v. קִיתוֹן. Y. Sabb. XII, end, 13
<sup>d</sup> וכתב לא השופך ‘and he writes’ (Deut. XXIV, 3), but not ‘he pours’ (a chemical fluid over a sympathetic writing to make it legible); ib. שופך דיו וכ' he pours ink in which there is no gall-nut, and this catches (settles on) the written letters; Y. Gitt. II, 44
<sup>b</sup> top שָׁפֵיךְ (Chald.); a. fr.—ש' דמים 
<italic>to shed blood</italic>. Gen. R. s. 34. B. Mets. 58
<sup>b</sup>, v. לָבַן II; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 16 שופכין, read: שׁוֹפְתִין, v. שָׁפַת.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁפַּךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be poured out, emptied</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 47
<sup>b</sup> ריאה 
<pgbrk id="pg1617" /> שׁנִשְׁפְּכָה כקיתוןa lung which (by tearing the membrane) is emptied like a ladle. Sot. 42
<sup>b</sup> (play on שופך, v. שׁוֹבַךְ) שכל הרואה אותו נ' לפניו וכ' whoever saw him, was poured out before him like a ladle (his courage failed him, cmp. מָסַס). Pes. 22
<sup>b</sup> דם שנ' כמים וכ' blood that is poured out like water makes susceptible of uncleanness. Ib.
<sup>a</sup> כמים הנִשְׁפָּכִין like water that is poured out (ordinary water), opp. המתנסכין used for libation. Ib. 20
<sup>b</sup> תִּשָּׁפֵךְ חבל, v. חֲבַל II. Zeb. VIII, 7, sq. יִשָּׁפֵךְ לאמה shall be poured into the sewer; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שִׁפֵּךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to make slanting</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. מְשׁוּפָּךְ. Yoma 68
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to שפך, Lev. IV, 12) שיהא מקומו מש' the place for the ashes must be sloping; Sifra Vayikra, Hob., Par. 3, ch. V; Zeb. 106
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01771">
<head-word>שָׁפֵל</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> Shaf. of נ־פל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be low</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁפִּיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to lower, humble</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 13
<sup>b</sup> המַשְׁפִּיל עצמו; הקב"ה מַשְׁפִּילוֹ, v. גָּבַהּ; Ned. 55
<sup>a</sup>. Pesik. R. s. 10 (ref. to Is. II, 9) אימתי שחו ונִשְׁפָּלוּ … הִשְׁפִּילָם הקב"ה when did they sink and were lowered? When they committed that deed (worshipped the golden calf), the Lord lowered them. Arakh. 15
<sup>b</sup> יַשְׁפִּיל דעתו let him humble his mind (think of his shortcomings). M. Kat. 16
<sup>b</sup> (play on ת̇ח̇כ̇מ̇נ̇י̇, II Sam. XXIII, 8) הואיל והִשְׁפַּלְתָּ עצמך ת̇ה̇א כ̇מ̇ו̇נ̇י̇ because thou didst lower thyself, thou shalt be like myself; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁפַּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be lowered</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. l. c., v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּשְׁפַּל, הָשְׁפַּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Ki Thissa, p. 11
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Is. II, 9) יודע … והָשְׁפַּלְתִּי אני והם וכ' I know that Israel bowed to the golden calf, and I and they have been lowered, but wilt thou not raise (forgive) them?; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 4 והשפלתי אותי and I myself have been lowered; Yalk. Is. 260 והוּשְׁפַּלְתִּי. Tanh. l. c. 5 (ref. to Ps. LXXV, 8) בלשון זה הו' וכ' for the word 
<italic>zeh</italic> (Ex. XXXII, 24) was he (Aaron) lowered, v. גָּבַהּ; בלשון זה הוּשְׁפָּלוּ וכ' through 
<italic>zeh</italic> (ib. 23) were they lowered, and with 
<italic>zeh</italic> (ib. XXX, 13) have they been raised; Lev. R. s. 8; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁתַּפֵּל, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁתַּפֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to let one’s self drop</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be humble, gentle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. s. 19 (ref. to שפלות ידים, Koh. X, 18) ע"י שנִשְׁתַּפְּלוּ ישראל מלחנות וכ' because the Israelites were too gentle to encamp (before Sinai) in discord &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be lazy, indolent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. ע"י … מִשְׁתַּפֵּל מלקנח וכ' (not לקנח) because that man is too careless to wipe his body properly, he gets scabs. Ib. ע"י … מִשְׁתַּפֶּלֶת וכ' because that woman is too indolent to examine her body properly &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִשְׁתַּפֵּל</binyan-form>

<entry id="U01773">
<head-word>שָׁפָל</head-word>
<head-word>שְׁפָלָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>low, humble</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 4
<sup>20</sup> ואל … ש' בעיני וכ' say not that I was low in the eyes of others, and was not despised in my own eyes. Taan. 16
<sup>a</sup>; Snh. 88

<number>—2)</number>

<sup>a</sup> דור … בשביל טובה שה' וכ' the generation of the flood became overbearing only on account of the wealth that the Lord bestowed upon them. Ib. בטובה שהִשְׁפַּעְתִּי וכ' with the very blessing that I bestowed upon them, do they provoke me to anger; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give overmeasure</italic>.</definition>

<sense>

<definition> [

<italic>to weigh, balance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 4 הכנס ורחוץ ושְׁקוֹל וכ' go in and bathe, and weigh thyself before and after &c.; כיון שיצא וש' וכ' when he came out and weighed himself, he had lost nothing. B. Bath. V, 11 היה שׁוֹקֵל לוֹ עין בעין if he gave him exact weight, v. עַיִן. Ib. 89
<sup>a</sup> לא יאמר לו שקול … אלא שוקל ליטרא וכ' he cannot say to him, weigh me three single fourths of a litra, but he weighs (puts in the balance) one litra, and puts one-fourth of a litra with the meat; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to weigh, consider, account</italic>. Koh. R. to XII, 14 עבד שרבו שוקל וכ' a slave to whom his master accounts errors as wilful offenses; Ḥag. 5
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. (ref. to Mal. III, 5) אוי לני שש' … קלות וכ' woe unto us to whom the Scripture accounts light offenses alike with severe crimes; Yalk. Mal. 589. Mekh. Yithro, s. 8 חביב … שש' כבודן וכ' the honoring of father and mother is precious before God, for he put their honor and the fear of them on a level with his own honor &c.; (Kidd. 30
<sup>b</sup> השוה); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of שֶׁקֶל) 
<italic>to offer the head-tax</italic> (half a Shekel).</definition>
<notes> Shek. I, 4 כל כהן ששוקל וכ' a priest that pays the head-tax. Ib. 6 השוקל על ידי וכ' if one pays the head-tax for a priest, a woman, or a minor, he is exempt (from paying agio). Ned. IV, 2 (33
<sup>a</sup>) את שקלו (לו)שוקל may pay the head-tax for him; a. fr.—In gen. 
<italic>to pay taxes</italic>. Tosef. Dem. VI, 3; 4; Y. ib. VI, end, 26
<sup>a</sup>, v. אוֹצָר.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. שָׁקוּל; f. שְׁקוּלָה; 
<plural-form>pl. שְׁקוּלִים, שְׁקוּלִין; שְׁקוּלוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>even-balanced, of equal importance</italic>. Snh. 3
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. אין בית דין ש' a court must never be even-balanced, i.e. not be of even numbers, opp. נוטה; v. בַּיִת. Num. R. s. 18
<sup>8</sup> (ref. to Ps. XCIX, 6) שמואל שש' כנגד וכ' Samuel who is balanced against Moses and Aaron together; Ber. 31
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to I Sam. I, 11, זרע אנשים) זרע שש' כנגד שני אנשים וכ' a seed (son) that will hold the balance against two men &c. Ib. 33
<sup>a</sup> מזכירין … שש' כתחיית וכ' we insert ‘the power of rain’ (v. גְּבוּרָה) in the section about resurrection, because it is equal to resurrection. B. Kam. 3
<sup>a</sup> ש' הן וכ' they (the two kinds of damages) are even-balanced (you cannot decide between the two), let both be included; Zeb. 4
<sup>b</sup>; Naz. 58
<sup>b</sup> ש' הוא the balance is even; Arakh. 4
<sup>b</sup>. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. XVII, Par. 14; Yalk. Lev. 462 (ref. to Lev. III, 4) הדבר ש' יטול וכ' it may be understood either way, he should take that part of the midriff which is by the liver, or a portion of the liver with the midriff &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁקִיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>to weigh, ponder, estimate</italic>.</definition>

<entry id="U01877">
<head-word>שָׁקַע</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be depressed, sink, go down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>c</sup> bot. אם היה חותמה שׁוֹקֵעַ if the seal on it was engraven, opp. בולט; Tosef. ib. V (VI), 2; Bab. ib. 43
<sup>b</sup>. Gen. R. s. 19 (ref. to לרוח היום, Gen. III, 8) לרוח ששׁוֹקַעַת עם היום by the (western) wind that goes down with the day. Ib. כל שהיום שוקע וכ' the more the day goes down, the cooler it grows. Y. Sabb. I, 3
<sup>d</sup> top אחד צף ואחד שוקע וכ' one kind of poison floats, another settles &c. Mikv. X, 1 צלוחית שפיה שוקע a bottle the mouth of which is turned down. Men. 103
<sup>b</sup>, v. 
<italic>Hithpa.</italic>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sink, let down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. V, 7 מששְׁקָעוֹ בכבשן after he let the lime stones down into the kiln (Y. ed. משיִשְׁקַע כבשנו, or משיְשַׁקֵּעַ) when he has filled his kiln). Yalk. Koh. 966, v. שָׁלָה; a. e.—Part. pass. שָׁקוּעַ; f. שְׁקוּעָה &c. Bekh. 43
<sup>b</sup>, v. חָרַם. Ex. R. s. 15
<sup>22</sup> והארץ ש' במים the earth was submerged in water. Sifra Thazr., Par. 5, ch. XV (ref. to פחתת, Lev. XIII, 55) שיהיו כל מראיה שְׁקוּעִין Rabad (ed. שׁוֹקְעִין) that all its colors appear lower (v. שַׁקִּיעַ; cmp. עָמוֹק); Yalk. Lev. 553 שׁוֹקְעִין; a. e.—Bekh. VII, 1 ראשו ש', v. שָׁקוּט.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שִׁיקֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to sink, let down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. VI, 4 מְשַׁקְּעִין את הקורה וכ' they insert the trunk (of the gallows) in the ground. Y. Shek. V, end, 49
<sup>b</sup> כמה ממון שִׁיקְּעוּ אבותי כאן how much money have my ancestors sunk here (in building that synagogue)!; כמה נפשות שיקעו וכ' how many souls did thy ancestors sink here! were there no people to study the Law (on whom that money might have been spent)?; Y. Peah VIII, end, 21
<sup>b</sup>. B. Mets. V, 7 Y. ed., v. supra; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to</italic>
<italic>embody in a collection without regard to original wording, to edit, abridge</italic>. Y. Hor. III, 48
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Sabb. XVI, 15
<sup>c</sup> הדא דאת אמר עד שלא ש' בו רבי רוב משניות אבל משש' וכ' what you say (that the study of the Mishnah collection is preferable) refers to the time before Rabbi had embodied and abridged most of the Mishnayoth in his edition, but since then, run at all times after the Talmud (where the discussions are quoted in their original form).—Part. pass. מְשׁוּקָּע; f. מְשׁוּקַּעַת; pl. מְשׁוּקָּעִים, מְשׁוּקָּעִין; מְשׁוּקָּעוֹת. Koh. R. to I, 15 מקצתה מש' בארץ part of the boat rests on dry land. Y. B. Mets. II, beg. 8
<sup>b</sup> במש' בו when the objeot is found stuck in it, opp. בנתון בו when it is seen that it was put there. Gen. R. s. 33 שהיתה התיבה מש' במים וכ' that the ark was eleven cubits in the water. Y. Yoma VII, beg. 44
<sup>a</sup> זרעו של דוד מש' שם the seed of David is sunk there (in the family of the Resh Galutha). Y. Sabb. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> top כסא שרגליו מש' בטיט a chair the feet of which stick in the mud. Y. Ḥag. I, 76
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Peah II, 17
<sup>a</sup> כמה … וכולהן מש' במשנה many Hălakhoth have been communicated to Moses from Sinai, and they all are embodied in the Mishnah; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁקִיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to sink, let down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 68 ה' הקב"ה גלגל וכ' the Lord caused the sun to set before its time. Ib. מה אתה בצאתך הִשְׁקַעְתִּי חמה וכ' as I caused the sun to set when thou didst go out &c. Lev. R. s. 21; Pesik. Aḥăre, p. 176
<sup>a</sup> לעולם יַשְׁקִיעַ וכ' (Ar. s. v. רתק: יְשַׁקֵּעַ or יִשְׁקַע) man should at all times sink himself into the study of the Mishnah, for when he knocks &c., v. רָתַק. Koh. R. to I, 5 עד שלא ה' שמשו … הזריח וכ' before God made the sun of Moses to set, he made the sun of Joshua to rise, v. שֶׁמֶשׁ. Ib. 4 היוצר הזה מַשְׁקִיעַ כבשונו מה שמשקיע וכ' the potter fills his oven; what he sinks into it first, is the last to come out; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁתַּקֵּע, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁתַּקֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be sunk, drowned; to be mixed up beyond recognition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII המִשְׁתַּקְּעִים שוקעים את שוקעיהן those that were to be drowned, drowned those that wanted to drown them. Ruth R. to I, 17 נ' … בחליו was three days unconscious on his sick-bed, opp. נתישבה דעתו he came to. Ex. R. s. 15
<sup>6</sup> מִשְׁתַּקְּעִין בעונות וכ' are sunk in sins through the evil inclination. Ib.
<sup>15</sup> עד שנִשְׁתַּקְּעוּ תהומות until the depths were filled with water. Y. Shek. VIII, beg. 51
<sup>a</sup> והיו עולי רגלים משתקעין וכ' the pilgrims sank in blood up to their knees; Men. 103
<sup>b</sup> שוקעין; Tosef. Eduy. III, 2 מפקיעין בדם וכ' ed. Zuck. (read: מְשׁוּקָּעִין; Var. מְשַׁקְּעִין את ארכובותיהן). Arakh. 6
<sup>b</sup> עד שלא נ' שם וכ' as long as the name of its owner (that donated it) is not merged (but is still traceable). Kidd. 75
<sup>a</sup> עד שיִשְׁתַּקֵּעַ שם ע"א ממנו until the name of idolatry has disappeared from him (until his idolatrous ancestry is no longer traceable). Y. Keth. I, 25
<sup>d</sup> top משפחה שנ' בה פסול וכ' if a genealogical blemish is mixed up in a family, you must investigate it back to four mothers; Y. Kidd. IV, 65
<sup>d</sup> bot. Ib. מה נאשה ונִשְׁתַּקְּעוּ בהן גדולי הדור what can we do (with these families), since prominent men of the generation are mixed up with them? Ib. חמשת … וכולם נשתקעו בכהונה וכ' Pashhur ben Imer had five thousand slaves, and they are all mixed up with high priestly families; Y. Yeb. VIII, 9
<sup>d</sup> top; (Kidd. 70
<sup>b</sup> נטמעו). Tanḥ. Noah 5 the Lord supported Noah שלא יִשְׁתַּקֵּעַ במעשה דור המבול lest he sink down in (the mud of) the deeds of the generation of the flood; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to settle permanently, be naturalized</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 301 (ref. to Deut. XXVI, 5 ויגר) מלמד … להִשְׁתַּקֵּע אלא לגור שם this shows that he (Jacob) did not go down (to Egypt) to settle there as a citizen, but only to sojourn there.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be lost</italic> in forests, fields &c. Y. Ber. II, end, 5
<sup>d</sup> ובשעה שהוא משתקע וכ' but when one is lost, he may even trespass on a field of crocus; (B. Kam. 81
<sup>a</sup> תועה).</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. l. c.; Y. B. Bath. V, 15
<sup>a</sup> bot. וראו … משתקע ובא כנגדן they saw R. J. b. P. having lost his way and coming (through fields) towards them.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<binyan-form>נִשְׁקַף</binyan-form>

<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to be bent towards</italic>,]

<sup>26</sup> (ref. to Num. XXI, 20) העומד … והוא הבאר הנִשְׁקָף וכ' he that stands on the face (plateau) of Jeshimon sees something in the sea (of Tiberias) …, and this is the well (of Miriam) which is seen from Jeshimon; (v. Lev. R. s. 22; Koh. R. to V, 8; Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>c</sup> bot.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁקִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to look, contemplate</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of שְׁקוֹף) 
<italic>to arch, curve, diminish the width of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 31 והיה מַשְׁקִיף בה ועולה וכ' and he curved it (the wall of the ark) as he went up &c., v. קַמְרוֹטוֹן; Yalk. ib. 54.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01881">
<head-word>שָׁקַף</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Shaf. of נ־קף, cmp. סְקַף II)
<italic>to bring in close contact, to knock</italic>.</definition>

Rashi a. l.) when God gives a man possession (of the Law), he rises to greatness; but if he raises himself, the Lord will lower him, and moreover, they will knock him down in the ground (play on ונשקפה Num. l. c. 20).</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>

<entry id="U01885">
<head-word>שָׁקַץ</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>

<entry id="U01893">
<head-word>שָׁקַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to be false</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 85, beg. שָׁקַרְתָּ יהודה thou hast been false, O Judah; Yalk. ib. 144; Yalk. Mal. 589.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שִׁיקֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same, same, 
<italic>to lie; to defraud</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—מה לי לשַׁקּר what reason should I have for making a false statement?, i.e. a person’s statement is to be credited, when he gains nothing by it, since he might have obtained the same advantage in another way. Kidd. 64
<sup>b</sup> אמרינן מה לי לשקר וכ' we apply the principle that we believe him, because he gains nothing by falsehood: for, why should he have said so? In order to release her from leviratical marriage after his death? If so, he might have said to her: I release thee by a divorce. Ib. מה לי לש' כי עדים דמי a person’s statement accepted on the ground that he had no reason for lying, has the same legal value as the statement of witnesses; מה לי לש' כי חזקה דמי it has only the same value as a presumption (חֲזָקָה). Keth. 27
<sup>b</sup> מה לי לש' אי בעי וכ' we must believe him, for, if he had wanted, he might have said &c. Ib. מה לי לש' במקום עדים וכ' we do not apply the principle of 
<italic>mah li l’shaḳḳer</italic>, when the person’s statement is contradicted by witnesses (by well-known facts); B. Mets. 81
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Y. Snh. XI, 30
<sup>c</sup> top (expl. כחש לו, I Kings XIII, 18) שי' בו (not ביה) he played him false; Cant. R. to II, 5 שי' לו; ib. ומה שי' לו שהאכילהו וכ' and wherein did he play him false? In that he gave him the bread of deceit to eat (made him the recipient of treacherous hospitality). Num. R. s. 20
<sup>18</sup>; Tanḥ. Balak 12 מְשַׁקֵּר במשקלות, v. מִשְׁקָל; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prove false; to contradict, refute</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Macc. 5
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Deut. XIX, 18) עד שתְּשַׁקֵּר גופה וכ' until thou disprovest the body of the testimony (provest an alibi of the witnesses).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁתַּקֵּר, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁתַּקֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be refuted, be proved to be a liar</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. ib. I, beg. 31
<sup>a</sup> [read:] עדים שנזדממו וחזרו ונִשְׁתַּקְּרוּ if witnesses against whom an alibi had been proved were also proved to have told a falsehood (as to the fact to which they testified).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>guardian angel, genius</italic>. Zeb. 116

<sup>b</sup> שר העולם the genius of the universe; Ḥull. 60
<sup>a</sup>. Ex. R. s. 22 נטל הקב"ה שר שלהם וכ' the Lord took first their (the Egyptians’) guardian angel and drowned him. Pes. 118
<sup>a</sup> שר הברד, v. יוּרְקָמִי. Ib. אני שר של אש I (Gabriel) am the angel of fire. B. Bath. 74
<sup>b</sup> שר של ים the angel of the sea. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 2 כיון שראו שָׂרָהּ של מלכות נופל (not נופלת) when they saw the genius of the (Egyptian) empire fallen; Yalk. Ex. 243; a. v. fr.—

R. s. 78, beg. מיכאל … שהם ש' של מעלה Michael and Gabriel who are the princes on high. Yalk. l. c. קרא … לכל שָׂרֵי האומות the Lord summoned all the tutelary angels of the nations. Cant. R. to VIII, 14 ש' של מעלה the princes on high (angels); ש' של מטה the earthly (human) governors. Ib. (play on הרי בשמים, ib.) המתינו לי … על הריהם שהם שָׂרֵיהֶם שנתונים אצלי בַּשָּׁמַיִם (not שנתונות) wait until I shall have sat in judgment over their mounts, that is, their chiefs that are placed with me in heaven; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 98 גני ש', v. גִּינֵּיסַר.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. שָׂרָה. Tosef. Ber. I, 12 (ref. to Gen. XVII, 15) בתחלה הרי היא ש' על עמה ועכשיו הרי היא ש' על אומות העולם ed. Zuck. (Var. שָׂרַי על עמה … על כל באי העולם, v. ed. Zuck. note) at first she was a princess of her own people, and now she is a princess for the nations of the world (for all that enter into the world); Ber. 13
<sup>a</sup> שרי לאומתה … ש' לכל העולם.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
